notes: JVM T2 (`bgraph-eval t2 --ecosystem jvm`). Root directory defaults to $BGRAPH_EVAL_DIR/t2/jvm: full clones <dir> detached at R (core.autocrlf=false), oracle.jsonl. Tools and caches come from $BGRAPH_EVAL_TOOLS (JDKs, Maven 3.9.9 with -Dmaven.repo.local=<tools>/m2, GRADLE_USER_HOME=<tools>/gradle-home, TEMP/TMP=<tools>/tmp). Suite: Maven `mvn -B -ntp -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore=true -pl <targets> test`, Gradle `gradlew --continue cleanTest test`; the unit is the Maven module / Gradle project and is red when any surefire / Gradle JUnit report of it has a failure or error. Baseline = 2 runs at R; red/differing units are excluded; each red unit is re-run alone (Maven `-pl <unit> -am`, Gradle `:p:test`) once to confirm. `mutants` = killed mutants aimed at, `tries` = mutants generated at most. Mutants are one-token operator flips (==/!=, <//>=, >//<=, &&/||, + / -, true/false) in non-test Java/Kotlin source under `include`; a mutant that does not compile is recorded as nocompile and not counted.
